title: 第19章 暗器第20章 院长弗兰德
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
宁苒苒哭笑不得：“你们想多了，我和三哥只是因为六年没见了，所以一整晚都在聊从前的经历，不知不觉就睡着了。”
“呼～那就好！”
宁荣荣长舒口气。
宁苒苒：“好了，弄半天我都饿了。
戴大哥，你知道食堂在哪吗？”
“走吧，我带你去，正好顺路。”
戴沐白大踏步先行，一群人浩浩荡荡跟着一起，要不是因为刚刚的误会，现在大家早就吃完饭了。
宁苒苒带着早餐回去的时候，唐三正好慌慌张张的下床。
“苒苒！
你去哪了？”
唐三看见宁苒苒急忙过去握住她的手，宁苒苒放下早餐不解：“我去吃早餐了，见你睡的熟，就没叫你，三哥是有急事？”
唐三松了口气：“没什么，还以为你又走了。”
宁苒苒哭笑不得：“三哥，我本来就是想进史莱克学院才来的，现在已经入学了，更何况我们还成了同学，我当然不会再走了。”
“快来吃饭，睡了这么久，你不饿吗？”
宁苒苒将唐三拉到桌前，唐三就势坐下，看着桌上的菜，一时沉默。
“怎么啦？是不喜欢吃吗？我记得你以前挺喜欢的啊！”
宁苒苒见状疑惑。
唐三：“没，没有，只是没想到你还记得我喜欢吃什么而已。”
就算是爸爸也从来没注意过他的喜好。
宁苒苒：“三哥你又犯傻，我当然记得啦！”

宁苒苒用手戳了戳唐三的脸，感叹道：“这么久不见，三哥不仅长高了还变黑了。”
唐三刚吃东西的嘴一噎，感觉心脏受到一万点暴击。
本来因为她的动作而耳尖泛红的颜色也变回正常的颜色。
等唐三吃完，两个人一起去了昨天打斗的地方，将现场还完好无损的暗器收了回来。
然后唐三就拉着宁苒苒到旁边说自己有东西送给她。
“苒苒，你看！”
唐三选了片空地，手中一小块晶石模样的石头，魂力瞬发之间，它仿佛一根细丝快如闪电直穿那棵大树。
一，二，三——
三秒钟的时间，那棵大树轰然倒下。
仔细一看，树干被绞得粉碎。
宁苒苒一整个被震撼住了：“这？好厉害啊！
三哥，这就是你说的暗器吗？”
宁苒苒知道唐三会暗器，但这还是第一次见识到暗器的威力！
唐三上前将它收回，手心中已然又变成原来的晶石模样。
“这是发金。”
唐三笑了笑将它递给宁苒苒看：“是我从板晶中收集出来的，我叫它龙须针。
现在我把它们送给你防身用，效果我已经展示给你看了。”
这……不就是书中描写的唐三从弗兰德手上得到的那块板晶？为什么唐三会把龙须针送给自己？宁苒苒疑惑不解：“三哥为什么想把它们送给我？你可以留着遇到危险用啊？”
content_en:
Ning Ranran didn't know whether to laugh or cry: "You are overthinking it. Third brother and I just haven't seen each other for six years, so we spent the whole night talking about our past experiences and fell asleep unknowingly."
"Huh~ That's good!"
Ning Rongrong breathed a long sigh of relief.
Ning Ranran: "Okay, I've been hungry for a long time.
Brother Dai, do you know where the canteen is? "
"Let's go, I'll take you there, I'm on my way."
Dai Mubai strode ahead, followed by a large group of people. If it hadn't been for the misunderstanding just now, everyone would have finished eating by now.
When Ning Ranran returned with breakfast, Tang San happened to get out of bed in a panic.
“Ran Ran!
Where have you been? "
Tang San saw Ning Ranran hurried over to hold her hand. Ning Ranran put down her breakfast and was puzzled: "I went to have breakfast. I saw you were sleeping soundly, so I didn't call you. Is Third Brother in a hurry?"
Tang San breathed a sigh of relief: "It's nothing, I thought you left again."
Ning Ranran didn't know whether to laugh or cry: "Third brother, I originally came here because I wanted to enter Shrek Academy. Now that I have enrolled, not to mention we have become classmates, of course I will not leave again."
"Come and eat. Aren't you hungry after sleeping for so long?"
Ning Ranran pulled Tang San to the table. Tang San sat down and looked at the dishes on the table, silent for a moment.
"What's wrong? Don't you like eating it? I remember you liked it before!"
Ning Ranran was confused when she saw this.
Tang San: "No, no, I just didn't expect you to still remember what I like to eat."
Even his father never paid attention to his preferences.
Ning Ranran: "Third brother, you are being stupid again, of course I will remember it!"
Ning Ranran poked Tang San's face with her hand and sighed: "We haven't seen each other for so long. Third brother has not only grown taller but also turned darker."
Tang San choked when he ate, and felt that his heart was hit by ten thousand points.
The red color at the tips of her ears due to her movements also returned to their normal color.
After Tang San finished eating, the two of them went to the place where they fought yesterday and took back the hidden weapons that were still intact.
Then Tang San pulled Ning Ranran to the side and said that he had something for her.
"Ran Ran, look!"
Tang San chose an open space and held a small piece of spar-like stone in his hand. When his soul power was instantly activated, it seemed like a thin thread running straight through the big tree as fast as lightning.
One, two, three——
In three seconds, the big tree fell down.
If you look closely, you can see that the tree trunk has been crushed to pieces.
Ning Ranran was completely shocked: "This? How amazing!
Third brother, is this the hidden weapon you are talking about? "
Ning Ranran knew that Tang San knew how to use hidden weapons, but this was the first time she saw the power of hidden weapons!
Tang San stepped forward to take it back, and the crystal in his hand had returned to its original shape.
"This is hair gold."
Tang San smiled and handed it to Ning Ranran: "I collected it from the plate crystals, and I call it the Dragon Beard Needle.
Now I give them to you for self-defense, and I have shown you the effect. "
Isn't this... the plate crystal that Tang San got from Flanders as described in the book? Why did Tang San give himself the Dragon Beard Needle? Ning Ranran was puzzled: "Why does Third Brother want to give them to me? Can you keep them for use in case of danger?"
